guard/30545.htm.text: Defender Proton: Greetings! I'm Proton, a Defender of this village. It's a good day to be outside, eh? But you should never let your guard down! There are some really bad monsters out here... You don't always take all of your possessions with you when you die!

links.text: "Who is the Lord of the manor and what is the tax rate?"

@questlist.text: Quest list window (the server lists the quests this NPC has for you; shown only when there is more than one).
